title: Suite lint diagnostics
description: The JSON document every binding's `lint --json` writes to standard output. An array, sorted by file, then line, then column, then code, then message, so two bindings cannot disagree by ordering. Codes and positions are the contract; message text is not.

code.description: A stable code from diagnostics.md. E1xx structural, E2xx semantic, E3xx dataflow and expression, W3xx warning. A code never changes meaning.

severity.description: error fails the lint. warning fails it only under --strict.

file.description: The suite file the finding is in, relative to the workspace root, with forward slashes and no backslash anywhere. Relative and slash-normalised so every binding on every operating system produce the same string. The rule is asserted by each binding's own tests rather than by a pattern here, because a pattern matching a backslash has to be escaped twice and is the sort of corner JSON Schema libraries disagree about.

line.description: One-based line of the offending node. Structural findings point at the key; dataflow and expression findings point at the value that carries the reference.

column.description: One-based column of the same node.

message.description: What is wrong, in one sentence. Not part of the conformance contract: a binding may word it differently.

suggestion.description: The nearest legal spelling, or the correction to make. Present only when the validator has one. Not part of the conformance contract.
